stepTitle: a) Look at the following four datasets. Rank them in order from weakest correlation to strongest correlation.

figureAlts.figure4.gif: (a) Look at the following four datasets. Rank them in order from weakest correlation to strongest correlation. Four scatter plots labeled A, B, C, and D. Plot A shows a weak correlation with scattered points. Plot B shows a moderate positive correlation. Plot C shows a strong negative correlation. Plot D shows no clear correlation with widely scattered points. Below the plots are blanks labeled Blank 1, Blank 2, Blank 3, and Blank 4, corresponding to weakest to strongest correlation.
